name: MyGov
description: An innovative citizen engagement platform launched by the Government of India to promote active participation of Indian citizens in their country's governance and development.
authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
services: Participate in policy discussions and polls
Submit ideas and feedback to government ministries
Participate in national contests, quizzes, and hackathons
Access verified government news and updates
eligibility: Open to all citizens of India and NRIs

name: DigiLocker
description: A flagship initiative under Digital India providing a secure cloud-based platform for storage, sharing, and verification of documents and certificates.
authority: National e-Governance Division (NeGD), MeitY
services: Secure digital storage of personal documents
Direct issuance of authentic digital certificates (Aadhaar, Driving License, Marksheets) from issuing authorities
e-Sign facility to digitally sign self-uploaded documents
Document verification APIs for government and private institutions
eligibility: Any Indian citizen holding a valid Aadhaar card linked to a mobile number

name: UMANG (Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance)
description: A unified platform offering access to pan-India e-Government services from Central, State, and local bodies via a single mobile application and web portal.
authority: National e-Governance Division (NeGD), MeitY
services: Access to EPF passbook and claim tracking
Utility bill payments (Bharat BillPay)
Access to PAN, Aadhaar, and DigiLocker services
Information on hundreds of Central and State government schemes
eligibility: All Indian citizens with a mobile number

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
description: A one-stop, digital platform for end-to-end processing of various scholarship schemes launched by the Central Government, State Governments, and UGC/AICTE.
authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
services: Student registration and application for multiple scholarship schemes
Online verification of applications by schools and institutes
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) of scholarship funds into students' bank accounts
Application status tracking
eligibility: Students from Class 1 to Ph.D. meeting respective scheme guidelines

name: Parivahan Sewa
description: A comprehensive national portal computerizing vehicle registration (Vahan) and driving licenses (Sarathi) to improve efficiency and transparency in transport administration.
authority: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways (MoRTH)
services: Apply for Learner's and Permanent Driving Licenses
Vehicle registration details and transfer of ownership
Online payment of road tax and e-Challans
Fancy number booking and national permit application
eligibility: Vehicle owners and driving license applicants in India

name: Passport Seva
description: The national portal for Indian passport application, renewal, and allied services aiming to deliver passport services to citizens in a timely, transparent, and accessible manner.
authority: Ministry of External Affairs (MEA)
services: Online application for fresh/re-issue of passports
Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) application
Appointment booking for Passport Seva Kendras (PSK)
Application tracking and fee payment
eligibility: Citizens of India

name: e-Shram Portal
description: A national database portal to register unorganized workers across the country, seeding their profiles with Aadhaar to facilitate the delivery of social security schemes.
authority: Ministry of Labour & Employment
services: Self-registration of unorganized workers
Issuance of Universal Account Number (UAN) e-Shram card
Integration with accidental insurance (PMSBY) and job portals
Profile updates and scheme matching
eligibility: Unorganized sector workers aged between 16 and 59 who are not EPFO/ESIC members and non-income tax payees

name: Udyam Registration Portal
description: The official Government of India portal for paperless, self-declaration based registration of Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs).
authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
services: New enterprise registration
Udyog Aadhaar Memorandum (UAM) to Udyam migration
Instant generation of Udyam e-Certificate
Integration with Income Tax and GST APIs for turnover verification
eligibility: Any entity starting or operating an MSME in manufacturing or services sector

name: Income Tax e-Filing Portal
description: The official e-filing portal of the Income Tax Department enabling taxpayers to file returns, respond to notices, and manage tax-related compliance digitally.
authority: Income Tax Department, Ministry of Finance
services: Filing of Income Tax Returns (ITR)
Instant e-PAN generation via Aadhaar
Link Aadhaar with PAN
View Annual Information Statement (AIS) and Form 26AS
e-Verification of returns and response to notices
eligibility: All Indian taxpayers, individuals, HUFs, and corporate entities

name: GST Portal
description: The common IT portal facilitating the registration, return filing, and tax payment processes for taxpayers under the Goods and Services Tax regime.
authority: Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN)
services: New GST Registration and amendment
Filing of GST Returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, etc.)
Generation of electronic way bills (e-Way Bill linkage)
Tax payment challan generation
Refund application and tracking
eligibility: All businesses registered or required to register under GST laws

name: eSanjeevani - National Telemedicine Service
description: The National Telemedicine Service of the Ministry of Health, offering tele-consultations between patients and doctors (OPD) directly from home.
authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
services: Free tele-consultations with registered doctors
E-prescription generation
Specialist OPD services
Patient health record management
eligibility: All Indian citizens seeking medical advice

name: ABHA Portal (Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission)
description: The official portal to create and manage the Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) ID, facilitating seamless digital health record sharing.
authority: National Health Authority (NHA)
services: Creation of 14-digit ABHA Number via Aadhaar/DL
Creation of ABHA Address (PHR Address)
Linking of health facility records to ABHA ID
Consent management for sharing health records
eligibility: All Indian citizens

name: Voter Services Portal (ECI)
description: The official online portal by the Election Commission of India offering a single window for voter registration, updates, and electoral roll searches.
authority: Election Commission of India (ECI)
services: New Voter Registration (Form 6)
Correction of entries in the Electoral Roll (Form 8)
Deletion or objection in electoral roll (Form 7)
Download e-EPIC (digital voter ID)
Search name in the voter list
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18 and above, or turning 18 on qualifying dates

verification.notes: Verified against the revamped ECI voter portal.

name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
description: An initiative of the Government of India to facilitate victims and complainants to report cybercrime complaints online, especially crimes against women and children.
authority: Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA)
services: Report Cyber Crime related to Women/Children (anonymously if desired)
Report Financial Cyber Fraud (Helpline 1930)
Report other cyber crimes (social media, hacking, ransomware)
Track complaint status
eligibility: Any citizen or entity who is a victim of cybercrime

name: MGNREGA Portal
description: The comprehensive MIS portal for the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act, tracking job cards, rural public works, and wage payments.
authority: Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD)
services: Job Card verification and tracking
FMR (Financial Management Report) and Muster Roll tracking
Geo-MGNREGA asset mapping viewing
Grievance registration and tracking
eligibility: Adult members of rural households seeking unskilled manual work

name: EPFO Member e-Sewa
description: A dedicated portal by the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation providing comprehensive digital services to EPF account holders.
authority: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), Ministry of Labour and Employment
services: UAN Activation and KYC linkage
Download PF Passbook
Online PF advance and final withdrawal claims
Track claim status
Transfer PF accumulation from previous employer
eligibility: Employees of formal sector organizations registered under the EPF Act

name: Jan Samarth Portal
description: A one-stop digital portal linking multiple Credit-Linked Government Schemes, allowing citizens to check eligibility and apply for subsidized loans.
authority: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
services: Eligibility check across Education, Agriculture, Business, and Livelihood loans
Online loan application routing to multiple banks
Real-time approval tracking from banks
Integration with CBDT, UIDAI, and state portals for digital verification
eligibility: Citizens, students, farmers, and entrepreneurs seeking government-subsidized credit

name: Skill India Digital (SID)
description: The state-of-the-art digital platform for the skilling, education, employment, and entrepreneurship ecosystem in India.
authority: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) / NSDC
services: Discover and enroll in PMKVY and other skilling courses
Access digital skill credentials and certificates via DigiLocker
Find apprenticeship and job opportunities via AI-matching
Location-based mapping of nearby training centers
eligibility: Youth, job seekers, and unorganized workers seeking upskilling

name: National Career Service (NCS)
description: A mission mode project providing a variety of employment-related services like job matching, career counseling, and vocational guidance.
authority: Ministry of Labour & Employment
services: Job seeker registration and resume building
Job search and application across private and government sectors
Access to career counselors and local job fairs
Employer registration for candidate search
eligibility: All Indian job seekers and registered employers

name: CPGRAMS (Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System)
description: An online platform available to citizens 24x7 to lodge their grievances to public authorities on any subject related to service delivery.
authority: Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG)
services: Register grievances against Central/State government departments
Track the status of lodged grievances
Send reminders/clarifications to the nodal officer
Appeal against resolved grievances if unsatisfied
eligibility: Any citizen of India facing issues with government service delivery

name: Government e-Marketplace (GeM)
description: The national public procurement portal offering an end-to-end online marketplace for Central and State Government Ministries, Departments, and PSUs to procure goods and services.
authority: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
services: Seller registration to sell products/services directly to government buyers
Tender and bidding participation for government procurement
Direct purchase, L1 buying, and reverse auctions
Incident management and payment tracking
eligibility: Any verified business, MSME, startup, or artisan capable of supplying goods/services

name: e-Courts Services Portal
description: A pan-India portal providing judicial services to litigants, lawyers, and the judiciary, covering High Courts and District Courts across the country.
authority: eCommittee, Supreme Court of India / Department of Justice
services: Search Case Status by CNR number, party name, or advocate
Access to daily cause lists
Download Court Orders and Judgments
e-Filing of cases and e-Pay for court fees/fines
eligibility: Litigants, Advocates, and general public

name: ORS (Online Registration System) - eHospital
description: A framework to link various hospitals across the country to enable Aadhaar-based online appointment booking and health record access for patients.
authority: National Informatics Centre (NIC) / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
services: Book OPD appointments at AIIMS and other central/state government hospitals
View and download lab reports
Check blood availability in linked blood banks
Teleconsultation appointment booking
eligibility: Any patient requiring consultation at registered government hospitals

name: National Single Window System (NSWS)
description: A digital platform for investors and businesses to identify and apply for various approvals, clearances, and registrations required to start a business in India.
authority: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
services: Know Your Approvals (KYA) module for personalized clearance mapping
Common Registration Form and single repository for documents
Apply for central and state-level business licenses online
Track approval status across ministries
eligibility: Domestic and international investors, corporate entities, and entrepreneurs

name: PM-Surya Ghar National Portal
description: The dedicated portal for the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, allowing residential consumers to apply for rooftop solar installations and central subsidies.
authority: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
services: Online application for rooftop solar technical feasibility
Selection of registered solar vendors
Submission of commissioning reports
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) claim for solar subsidy
eligibility: Residential electricity consumers with suitable rooftop space

name: e-RaktKosh
description: A centralized blood bank management information system facilitating citizens to check real-time blood availability across authorized blood banks in India.
authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / C-DAC
services: Real-time blood stock availability search by location and blood group
Find nearby blood banks and blood donation camps
Register as a voluntary blood donor
Access Thalassemia and Hemophilia care centers
eligibility: All citizens needing blood or willing to donate

name: NGO-DARPAN
description: A platform that provides space for interface between Voluntary Organizations (VOs) / Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs) and key Government Ministries/Departments.
authority: NITI Aayog / National Informatics Centre (NIC)
services: Registration of NGOs/VOs to obtain a Unique ID
Requirement for receiving government grants and FCRA registration
Directory of registered NGOs across India
Information on government grant schemes for NGOs
eligibility: Registered Societies, Trusts, and Section 8 Companies operating as NGOs/VOs

name: Jeevan Pramaan
description: A biometric-enabled digital service for pensioners of Central Government, State Government, and other Government organizations to submit their life certificates digitally.
authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
services: Generation of Digital Life Certificate (DLC) using Aadhaar biometrics/Face authentication
Direct digital submission to the Pension Disbursing Agency (Bank/Post Office)
Locate nearby Jeevan Pramaan centres (CSC)
Download PDF of generated life certificate
eligibility: Pensioners receiving pension from Central Govt, State Govt, EPFO, and other participating organizations
